title: Customer Success Executive
jobDescription: About Mudrex Mudrex is one of India's leading crypto investment platforms, backed by Y Combinator and Nexus Venture Partners. We help users invest in digital assets through products built around simplicity, security, and trust. The role of Customer Success at Mudrex is the front line of customer trust. You'll own end-to-end interactions across chat, email, calls, and social, and stay accountable from first response to final resolution. Whether it's a product question or an escalation on user funds, the ticket is yours to solve. Suited for someone who thinks on their feet, writes well, and treats every ticket as a chance to build the brand. What you'll do Resolve customer queries across chat, email, calls, and social channels Own escalations end-to-end and drive them to resolution Educate users on Mudrex products, trading, and platform policies Partner with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Tech to fix root causes, not just close tickets Surface recurring issues and propose process improvements Become a subject matter expert on Mudrex products and crypto fundamentals Consistently meet defined KPIs and quality benchmarks across all customer interactions You should have 2-3 years in Customer Support, Customer Success, or Operations Strong written and verbal communication in English and Hindi Basic understanding of how trading and futures work Confidence handling calls and difficult conversations Sharp problem-solving and attention to detail Comfort working rotational shifts including weekends and occasional nights Added Advantage if experience is in fintech, crypto/Web3, trading platforms, or wealth management. Bengaluru · On-site · Full-time · Rotational shifts (24x7 ops)

title: Sr. Associate - PR & Communications
jobDescription: About Mudrex Mudrex is India's leading crypto investment platform, backed by Y Combinator, Nexus Venture Partners, and Arkam Ventures. We make crypto investing simple, safe and accessible for millions of Indians, from first-time investors in tier 2 and 3 cities to experienced traders. Our B2B infrastructure brand, Saber Money, is building stablecoin-native cross-border payment rails for Asia. Together, Mudrex and Saber are at the intersection of the two most significant shifts in global finance, the mainstreaming of digital assets and the transformation of cross-border payments. The PR & Communications team drives how both brands are perceived by media, by policymakers, by the industry, and by the public. The Role We are looking for a Senior Associate, PR & Communications to bring editorial judgment, strategic thinking, research depth, and cross-functional coordination to the PR and Communications team. You will work closely with the PR & Communications team lead to support spokesperson management, media relations, intelligence gathering, content production and communications for Mudrex. The right person obsessively reads the news, has a feel for what makes a story, and can write well under pressure. What You Will Do Media Monitoring & Intelligence Run a structured daily media monitoring process across domestic and global publications, tracking industry narratives, regulatory developments, competitor activity and emerging themes relevant to Mudrex. Monitor social media platforms daily for brand mentions, competitor moves and trending narratives in crypto, fintech, markets, finance and policy. Synthesise monitoring outputs into brief, actionable intelligence notes that allow the team to respond quickly or plan proactively. Media Relations & Press Draft and distribute press releases, media pitches, spokesperson quotes and reactive statements for news and media outlets. Support the development and maintenance of direct journalist relationships in collaboration with external agencies. Coordinate media opportunities end-to-end from pitching and follow-up to briefing materials and post-coverage tracking. Content & Thought Leadership Research market trends, regulatory developments and crypto investment themes to support spokesperson social media profile building, story pitches, and expert commentary for organic and paid channels, as well as owned content covering text, visual, audio and video formats. Write and edit first drafts of op-eds, bylined articles and expert commentary for spokespeople, with a strong grasp of distinct tones of voice. Contribute to proprietary research properties including data reports, survey analyses, and flagship publications. Spokesperson & Campaign Support Prepare briefing documents, talking points, interview prep packs and background research for spokesperson media interactions and public appearances. Support the profiling of multiple leaders across print, digital, podcast and broadcast formats. Assist in planning and executing PR campaigns, including thematic initiatives tied to market trends, regulatory events and products. Policy & Industry Engagement Monitor policy developments and regulatory announcements relevant to crypto, stablecoins and fintech in India and international markets. Support Mudrex's engagement with industry bodies by tracking consultations, reviewing guidelines and preparing contribution inputs. Operations & Coordination Manage day-to-day coordination with external agencies and freelancers, including briefings, content reviews and coverage reporting. Maintain editorial calendars, task trackers, and coverage databases. Coordinate paid media partnerships and cross-functional PR collaborations across internal teams. What We Are Looking For Experience & Background 3 to 4 years of experience in PR, communications or financial journalism, ideally in fintech, crypto, financial services or a fast-paced startup environment. Demonstrable experience drafting press materials such as press releases, op-eds, media pitches and spokesperson quotes that have been placed or published. Experience running end-to-end PR and brand campaigns from conceptualisation and execution to tracking performance and outcomes. Experience working with or alongside an external PR agency is preferred. Prior exposure to crypto, Web3, fintech or finance is a strong advantage. Skills & Competencies Strong English writing ability that is clear, concise, and adaptable across formats, from a media pitch to social media content to a CEO op-ed. Research capability: Ability to read a financial regulatory document, a market trend piece or a competitor announcement and extract what matters for a communications angle. Editorial instinct: A sense of what is newsworthy, what is not, and how to frame a story for different audiences. Organised and reliable under pressure, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, English, Economics or a related field. Candidates with non-traditional backgrounds who have built strong writing and research skills through their careers are equally welcome. Proficiency with AI and project coordination tools. Familiarity with media monitoring and reporting tools is preferred.

title: Sr Manager, Business Development
jobDescription: The Sr Manager, Business Development will lead the strategy, acquisition, and management of Mudrex’s B2B2C distribution network. This role is responsible for expanding and scaling our ecosystem of sub-brokers, master brokers, trading schools, authorized personnel, and fund managers. The ideal candidate will drive daily sales operations to onboard new partners, optimize commission structures for mutual profitability, and directly manage spot and futures trading volume targets across the entire partner network. Key Responsibilities Sub-Broker & Master Broker Network Expansion Design and execute targeted digital and outbound campaigns to identify and onboard new sub-brokers and authorized personnel across diverse geographies. Establish and scale a Master Broker model, identifying regional partners capable of recruiting, managing, and driving trading activity within sub-broker networks beneath them. Source, onboard, and manage relationships with asset managers and fund managers with established HNI client networks. Trading School Engagement & Onboarding Target, pitch, and secure strategic partnerships with trading schools, educational institutes, and retail trading communities. Implement dedicated enablement strategies and tailored support frameworks to help trading schools successfully transition their student base into active traders on Mudrex. Partner Activation and Volume Management Own and achieve specific spot and futures trading volume targets driven through the entire partner distribution network. Oversee daily sales and account operations to ensure partners with small-to-large customer bases are consistently active and productive. Coordinate cross-functionally to provide all partner segments with necessary marketing collateral, operational enablement tools, and priority customer support. Infrastructure and Commercial Operations Manage strategic relationships with third-party infrastructure providers, including algorithmic trading and signal providers, to ensure stable trading options and sustained volume for partner clients. Evaluate, design, and manage competitive yet profitable commission and reward structures that incentivize long-term partner retention, optimize spot/futures distribution, and ensure scalable revenue growth. Collaborate with internal compliance and product teams to ensure all partnership frameworks, referral models, and fund management operations adhere to regional regulatory standards. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, B2B2C sales, or partnership management within the fintech, brokerage, traditional finance, or cryptocurrency sectors. Proven track record of owning and achieving trading volume targets, specifically within spot and derivatives/futures markets. Experience building and managing multi-tiered affiliate, sub-broker, or franchisee distribution networks. Demonstrated success in building corporate partnerships with educational entities, trading academies, or retail financial communities. Experience managing high-value relationships with institutional clients, HNI fund managers, and external technical infrastructure vendors. Strong financial acumen with experience designing and optimizing commercial commission models, revenue-share frameworks, and incentive structures. Exceptional leadership skills with a history of managing targets and leading business development or relationship management teams. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field. Key Performance Metrics Volume targets achieved for both spot and futures trading across the partner network. Total growth and geographic expansion of the partner network, categorized by sub-brokers and trading schools. Active partner ratio and overall trading volume driven through partner networks. Net revenue generated from partnerships relative to payout and commission costs.

title: Senior Product Manager, Investments & Derivatives Products
jobDescription: Experience: 4-6 years in product management, with meaningful time on a trading or investments product Reports to: Senior Director of Product Management About the role Mudrex is one of India's leading crypto investment platforms. Our derivatives business, USDT and INR perpetual futures alongside Spot trading, is the fastest-growing part of the platform, and we are scaling both the product surface and the team behind it. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the execution roadmap for our derivatives and investment products. You will own sprint-level product decisions end to end: what ships, in what order, with what trade-offs, working directly with our engineering pods, design, and growth. The Director retains portfolio strategy; you own everything between strategy and shipped product, and you are expected to make calls without escalating routine domain questions. This is a high-leverage role on a real-money, real-time system. Mistakes here cost users money. You should find that motivating, not frightening. What you will own Sprint-level product ownership across Futures (USDT and INR perpetuals) and Spot: backlog definition, prioritization, trade-off decisions, and release quality across multiple engineering pods. PRDs and specs for trading features such as advanced order types, charting integrations, margin and leverage flows and order lifecycle edge cases. Your specs should be precise enough that engineering rarely needs a clarification round. Trading mechanics correctness: funding rates, margin and liquidation behavior, fee and tax handling (TDS, GST), INR/USDT translation flows, and reconciliation edge cases. You will be the first line of judgment on whether an edge case is a P0. Metrics ownership for your surface: trading volume, order success rates, funnel conversion from deposit to first trade, and feature adoption. You define instrumentation, not just consume dashboards. Cross-functional coordination with quant, risk, compliance, design, and growth, including campaign and activation infrastructure tied to trading behavior. Competitive intelligence: you should know what Delta Exchange, CoinDCX, Binance, and Bybit shipped last quarter and have a view on what matters. What we are looking for 4-6 years in product management , with at least 2 years on a trading, broking, derivatives, or exchange product. Indian broking F&O (equity or commodity derivatives), crypto exchanges, or trading infrastructure are the strongest fits. Working fluency in derivatives mechanics: you can explain funding rates, mark vs. last price, initial vs. maintenance margin, and liquidation waterfalls without looking them up. Strong written PRD discipline. You write specs that enumerate edge cases, define acceptance criteria, and survive contact with engineering. Analytical self-sufficiency: comfortable with SQL or equivalent, able to pull your own funnel and cohort data, and able to instrument new features correctly. Decision-making under ambiguity: evidence that you have owned calls with real downside, and a track record of escalating the right 10% rather than the easy 50%. Operating cadence: you have run multi-pod or multi-squad sprint processes and kept velocity without becoming a ticket administrator. Strong signals (not required) You trade derivatives yourself, in crypto or Indian F&O. Experience building on third-party exchange or liquidity infrastructure. Exposure to Indian crypto regulation and tax mechanics (1% TDS, Section 194R, GST treatment). Experience with TradingView or charting library integrations. Prior 0-to-1 or early-scale experience where you wore both execution and strategy hats. What this role is not It is not a delivery manager or scrum master role. You own product decisions, not just ceremonies. It is not a strategy-only role. You will be in the details of order states, fee ledgers, and reconciliation flows weekly. It is not a role for someone who needs a fully de-risked spec handed to them. You write the spec. Why Mudrex Derivatives volume has scaled more than 10x and continues to compound; you will own a surface that materially moves company revenue. Small, senior product team with direct access to leadership and short decision loops. You inherit a mature product operating system: established pod structures, PRD standards, and roadmap processes, so you can focus on product judgment, not process invention. Hiring process Intro call with the hiring manager (30 min) Domain and product depth round: derivatives mechanics, edge-case reasoning, prioritization (60 min) Written exercise: a short PRD or teardown on a real trading feature (take-home, time-boxed) Cross-functional round with engineering and design leads Founder/leadership conversation

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobDescription: Mudrex is a Y Combinator-backed organization on a mission to democratize investing. Retail investors use Mudrex to invest in crypto easily. Our flagship product, Coin Sets, has seen amazing traction in the markets we have launched. We are growing rapidly, and to sustain and support this growth, we are expanding our team. The folks at Mudrex are young, driven, and dedicated to building a self-sustaining platform that simplifies investing in cryptocurrency. About the Role You'll be the technical bridge between our clients and our product. From helping developers integrate our payments API to shaping how our platform evolves your work directly impacts both client success and our roadmap. What You'll Do ● Own the technical onboarding of new clients from first API call to production go-live ● Guide client engineering teams through integration of our payments and settlements APIs/SDKs ● Diagnose and resolve technical issues across integration, configuration, and platform behaviour ● Serve as the voice of the client internally synthesize patterns from client feedback and translate them into actionable inputs for the dev team ● Build and maintain integration guides, code samples, and troubleshooting playbooks ● Work cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to influence the dev roadmap based on real client pain points What We're Looking For ● 3+ years in a solutions engineering, developer support, or integration engineering role ● Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and SDK integration patterns ● Proficient in Go or backend language (Python, Node.js); able to write and debug integration-level code independently ● Working knowledge of React or similar frontend frameworks; able to understand and debug client-side integration issues ● Experience in fintech, payments, or crypto is a strong plus ● Clear communicator — comfortable explaining technical concepts to both developers and non-technical stakeholders ● Structured thinker who can spot recurring client issues and turn them into systemic fixes Nice to Have ● Familiarity with payment rails ● Prior experience at a B2B SaaS or API-first company

title: Senior Manager - Compliance
jobDescription: Mudrex is a Y Combinator-backed organization on a mission to democratize investing. Retail investors use Mudrex to invest in crypto easily. Our flagship product, Coin Sets, has seen amazing traction in the markets we have launched. We are growing rapidly, and to sustain and support this growth, we are expanding our team. The folks at Mudrex are young, driven, and dedicated to building a self-sustaining platform that simplifies investing in cryptocurrency. As digital finance rapidly transforms, the sophistication of illicit activities keeps pace. We are seeking a seasoned AML Compliance Manager with an investigative mind and extensive background in anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing (CFT) oversight, ideally with a focus on blockchain technologies and digital assets. In this position: you won't just interpret regulations, you'll shape compliance strategies, coach a team of compliance professionals, and work directly with product and risk leaders to strengthen our company's posture against financial crimes. Core Job Responsibilities KYC / KYB & Due Diligence: To Design Customer/Corporate Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Sanctions Screening procedures for cross-border remittances and merchant settlements business. Transaction Monitoring & Analytics: Oversee real-time transaction monitoring as well as periodic review cycles; analyze escalations, approve high-risk cases, and ensure the quality and consistency of case resolutions. To Implement Using blockchain tool Chainalysis to trace digital assets, flag high-risk wallet activity, and execute Suspicious Transaction Reports (SAR/STRs). Global Regulatory Adherence: Enforcing international and local frameworks, including the FIU, FINTRAC , FATF Travel Rule , MiCA , MAS, VARA and VASP (Virtual Asset Service Provider) registration obligations and ensuring PMLA compliances and reporting are adhered to on a timely basis. Licensing & Regulator Relations: To contributes and support the Expansion team in terms of licensing, PMLA guidelines implementation, coordinated with Product and Tech to get the process implemented. Further, Acting as the primary liasoning person with compliance officers/Incubators at difference geographical locations of Saber Business. To ensure the timely review and implementation of Governance, policy and operating procedures related to Saber Money global business. To ensure the Audit management for the Saber Money global business Operational Excellence & Data-Driven Decision Making Lead the development of compliance dashboards and management reports for periodic review by leadership and external stakeholders. Work with engineering and product teams to automate, scale, and enhance compliance processes including system tuning for transaction monitoring and false positive reduction. Why Join Us: Crypto Innovation: Be at the forefront of a rapidly growing and evolving crypto trading platform. Learning Opportunities: Gain deep insights into the crypto market and product management in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Career Growth: Opportunity for career advancement and mentorship within the product management team. Collaborative Culture: Work alongside passionate professionals in the blockchain and fintech sectors.
